description_en: Queries the execution list and status of Cloud Assistant scripts
description_zh: 用于查询云助手脚本的执行列表和状态
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-invocations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --invoke-id t-hz0jdfwd9f0000 --command-type RunPowerShellScript --invoke-status Finished --desktop-id ecd-7w78ozhjcwa3u0000 --include-output false --content-encoding PlainText --max-results 10 --next-token AAAAAV3MpHK1AP0pfERHZN5pu6nmB7qrRFJ8vmttjxPL0000 --end-user-id alice --desktop-ids ecd-84mztzatmipf20000 --include-invoke-desktops true --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInvocations

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The script execution ID. Obtained from the response of [RunCommand](~~RunCommand~~)
parameters.help_zh: 脚本进程执行ID。取自[RunCommand](~~RunCommand~~)的返回参数
parameters.name: invoke_id

parameters.help_en: The command type of the O&M script
parameters.name: command_type

parameters.help_en: The overall execution status of the script. The overall execution status depends on the combined execution status of one or more cloud desktops in the execution
parameters.help_zh: 脚本执行的总执行状态。总执行状态取决于创建执行中的一台或多台云电脑的共同执行状态
parameters.name: invoke_status

parameters.help_en: The cloud desktop ID. If you specify a cloud desktop, all script execution records for that cloud desktop are queried
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑ID。如果指定了云电脑，则查询该云电脑所有的脚本执行记录
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the output of the script execution in the results
parameters.help_zh: 是否在结果中返回脚本运行的输出信息
parameters.name: include_output

parameters.help_en: The encoding method of the returned data
parameters.name: content_encoding

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.    

Maximum value: 50.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    

最大值：50。
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The list of cloud desktop IDs.

The `DesktopId` parameter will be deprecated. Use this parameter to pass the list of cloud desktop IDs
parameters.help_zh:
云电脑ID列表。

`DesktopId`参数即将弃用，请使用当前参数传递云电脑ID列表信息
parameters.name: desktop_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the execution results of all cloud desktops when a remote command is run on multiple cloud desktops
parameters.help_zh: 远程命令在多台云电脑上执行的情况下，是否返回所有云电脑的执行结果
parameters.name: include_invoke_desktops
